text:
The abstract describes a polyacrylamide‑titanium dioxide (PAA@TiO₂) nanocomposite prepared by a cross‑linking method and evaluated for crystal violet adsorption, with characterization and molecular simulations confirming its performance. It makes no mention of biochar, hydrothermal carbonisation, agricultural waste precursors, silver nanoparticle functionalisation, or real‑time UV‑Vis monitoring. Therefore, the study’s evidence does not support the candidate hypothesis presented.

VERDICT: REJECT
